class: RC1 WP1.2 acceptance stage and verdict
change: After the identity check and the release probes, scripts/dev_acceptance_stage.py run (with --crawl-frontend-dir) runs the existing execute-plans crawl scripts/accept-management-hosted-production.mjs at the deployed frontend commit against the served pair as the read-only viewer and adds one required check, check:management-crawl (passed / failed with failedRoutes / skipped with reason). nonprod-deploy.yml dev-acceptance-stage gains two credential-free steps before the lease (checkout of ajoe734/execute-plans at frontend_sha; npm ci + Chromium install, 20 min timeout) and uploads acceptance-crawl.json beside the verdict.

verdict_rules.passed: no effect on the verdict (the crawl's own result.pass is true)
verdict_rules.failed: verdict failed; detail and failedRoutes name each route, its status and the render error
verdict_rules.skipped: verdict pending, never passed; reasons stack_not_verified, frontend_not_prepared, crawl_script_missing, viewer_credential_missing, viewer_login_failed, crawl_deadline, crawl_no_report, crawl_internal_error
verdict_rules.deploy_job: unchanged in all cases: the stage exits 0, the job is continue-on-error, nothing rolls back

start_condition: the job needs coordinate-dev-release success (switch done, stack verified); the crawl also requires check:deployed-pair-identity passed, otherwise skipped: stack_not_verified

time_limit.basis: pre-switch crawl step 'Management hosted production acceptance' in execute-plans gate runs on 2026-11-24 that minted a credential: 45364275324 421 s, 45401183199 361 s, 45428583657 373 s, 45453849299 328 s, 45472712064 334 s, 45500113085 374 s; longest 421 s plus about 70 % margin
time_limit.on_expiry: process group (node and Chromium) killed; skipped: crawl_deadline

read_only.identity: existing viewer (vars.DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_ID / secrets.DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_SECRET), still only in the 'Run acceptance checks and probes' step env; the crawl process receives only the short-lived token
read_only.requests: browser GET only; PANTHEON_ACCEPT_CLICK_WRITE_CTAS=0; the one POST is the existing /bff/auth/dev-login exchange that release probes already use; any non-GET BFF request seen is listed in the artifact
read_only.hosted_writer: none new; latest.json beside the release store stays one replaced document

runtime_budget.added_per_release: about 7 to 8 min: checkout ~2 s, install ~36 s (same step shape in Root 45684275970, 20:36:12Z-20:36:48Z), crawl 5.5 to 7 min; bounded at 20 min install + 12 min crawl
runtime_budget.runner_minutes_per_day: about 65 typical (8.7 x 7.5), about 130 on a 16-release day; ceiling 16 x 32.5 = 520 if every bound were hit
runtime_budget.artifact: acceptance-crawl.json 15 KB for 109 passing routes, 70 KB if all 109 routes fail; added to the existing dev-acceptance-verdict-<run>-<attempt> artifact, 30-day retention; verdict grows by at most ~21 KB (failedRoutes capped at 50, error text at 240 characters)

release probes and run_stage; without --crawl-frontend-dir the verdict is as before
no rollback, no new blocking gate on the deploy path, no new dispatch input
